rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/hq/v1/accounts/:account_id/users/import
POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/hq/v1/regions/eu/accounts/:account_id/users/import
app only
account:write
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a two-legged OAuth flow.
Must be application/json

Specifies the region where the service is located.                                                                                                        Possible values: US, EMEA. For the full list of supported regions, see the Regions page.
The account/hub ID of the users. This corresponds to hub ID in the Data Management API. To obtain hub ID you need to remove the “b.” prefix. For example: b.c8b0c73d-3ae9 becomes c8b0c73d-3ae9.
The user’s default company ID in BIM 360

User’s email
